svg.title: Self-attention for she in the six-token Noa prefix
svg.desc: Noa, can, be, annoying, but, she occupy positions 0 through 5. Compare the she embedding at position 5 with the six available embeddings, normalize with softmax, and form the weighted sum. Later words are excluded. Other queries use their own causal prefixes. Feature cells are schematic.

g.text: softmax across the six available scores
